#### What this PR does / why we need it:
To mitigate transient GitHub errors, the Spark operator chart is pulled not from `kubeflow.github.io` but over OCI from `oci://ghcr.io/kubeflow/helm-charts/spark-operator`, and the install is wrapped in a retry.

<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

The PR refactors the Spark Operator installation in the e2e test suite by switching from a Helm repository-based chart to a configurable OCI chart reference and wrapping the Helm command with retry logic to handle transient network failures.

## Changes

**Spark Operator Helm Installation Refactor**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Spark Operator Helm chart and install refactor** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`|Chart configuration switches from `spark-operator/spark-operator` (repository-based) to a configurable OCI reference (`SPARKOPERATOR_HELM_CHART`, defaulting to `oci://ghcr.io/kubeflow/helm-charts/spark-operator`); Helm repository add is removed, and install/upgrade invocation is refactored into an `install_args` array and executed via `hack/testing/retry.sh` with 7 attempts and exponential backoff while preserving namespace creation, wait, image tag, and empty `spark.jobNamespaces[0]` behavior.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#11951](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/11951): Injects Spark test image preload into kind immediately before the Helm-based Spark Operator installation refactored in this PR.
